text:
Hello everyone,🎉🎉🎉
My husband is Israeli and I am Turkish. We met and got married in Turkey. After about five years, today I officially received my Israeli citizenship.❤️

I would like to sincerely thank everyone here and at AIC for all your help. You’ve built an amazing community, you answered all our questions and made it possible for many people in the same situation to support one another.

We started our process in June 2021 in the Ramle branch as a married couple and I got B1.

🗓️ First received A5 in December 2021.

🗓️ Applied for citizenship in September 2025 and had the interview for the citizenship in December 2025. Every couple of weeks after that we were asked by MH for more and more follow up documents, including filling קורות חיים לאבחון for the first time in the gradual process. Finally, earlier this week we were told that the application was approved and were invited to receive the citizenship.

We wish everyone success in this process. We are truly happy to be part of this community. האגודה הישראלית לזוגות בינלאומיים aic.org.il
